name: Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (SART)
definition: SART is an iterative reconstruction technique for X-ray tomography that solves the linear system $Ax = p$. It provides better reconstruction quality than ART, is amenable to parallelization using graphics hardware, and has an intuitive geometric interpretation for its update equation.
summary: Simultaneous Algebraic Reconstruction Technique is an iterative method that reconstructs 3D volumes from 2D projections by updating all rays in a projection concurrently, offering faster convergence and better noise stability than ART.
